Jan-Aug 2026 consolidated sales (NT$15,258M) by customer application: smartphone 30%, AI.CPU/GPU.ASIC.SiPh 24%, networking/IoT 21%, consumer 19%, automotive 6%; Jan-Aug 2025 (NT$12,663M): smartphone 33%, networking/IoT 22%, AI.CPU/GPU.ASIC.SiPh 20%, consumer 18%, automotive 7%. quarterly_data.signal: Company outlook (deck): in 2H26, despite cost pressures from rising memory prices in certain end applications, testing demand continues to strengthen for AI servers, CPUs/GPUs, ASICs, AI Connectivity, silicon photonics, 2nm high-end smartphone chips, LEO satellites, high-speed networking and silicon capacitors.

Hukou Plant II (total floor area 28,107.66 m2) commenced mass production in July 2026 and continues to ramp up; the deck keeps Chuangshing Plant III (36,340 m2) on schedule for 4Q26 completion and 1Q27 mass production. The company says that as new equipment and capacity come online it will further enhance its advanced testing capabilities and capacity flexibility.
quarterly_data.figure: Hukou Plant II mass production July 2026; Plant III completion 4Q26, mass production 1Q27

quarterly_data.signal: Early capacity reservations (company): some customers have secured testing capacity in advance through capacity reservation agreements and dedicated tester reservations, supporting upcoming new product introductions and mass production requirements and improving mid- to long-term visibility for orders and capacity demand. Customers are not named.

Capex (deck): in July 2026 subsidiary Sigurd UTC added NT$2.0B in capex to expand testing capacity for a U.S. CPU/GPU customer (not named); full-year 2026 capex stands at NT$8.8B after the NT$2.82B increase in May.
quarterly_data.figure: Sigurd UTC added capex NT$2.0B (July 2026) for a U.S. CPU/GPU customer

quarterly_data.signal: End-to-end silicon photonics OSAT services (deck): PIC wafer sorting (insertion 1; 300mm wafer chuck, temperature RT to 200C, 6-axis nano-positioner, O-O / O-E / E-O test, VCSEL LIV/NF/RF), a wafer-to-die process (Stealth Dicing, grinding and polish, die separation, AOI inspection), bumping and flip chip (uBump, CuP, mixed bump), optical engine wafer test (insertion 2; EIC top + PIC bottom double-side test on a 300mm GridChuck) and optical engine die test (insertion 3; left / right edge and grating coupling test, PnP automation loader). R&D also covers high-power burn-in testing technologies and equipment.
